newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Ah takes legal action against govt.
newsitem.headline: Dong Ah takes legal action against govt.

text.p: South Korea's Dong Ah Construction Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday it had filed a complaint against the government's decision to revoke the company's licence to build steel-framed bridges.
"We decided to take legal action because the construction ministry's decision is unfair," said a Dong Ah statement.

Earlier on Thursday the ministry said it had revoked Dong Ah's licence saying the company was responsible for "mismanaging" construction of the steel-framed Songsu bridge which collapsed in October 1994, killing 32 people.
"Dong Ah would be banned from receiving new orders to build steel-framed bridges," a ministry official said.
Dong Ah's bridge construction takes up less than seven percent of the company's total construction, he said.
Shares of Dong Ah closed down 1,400 won on Thursday at 17,900.
